Townhome dwelling unit fire wall separation requirements (1-hour or 2-hour ratings) are not noted on the cover sheet, site plan, or floor plans. Provide fire wall rating designations for wall separations between individual townhome units per applicable building code requirements.

Fire wall separation rating (1-hour or 2-hour) between townhome units is not noted on the cover sheet or floor plans. This information is required for townhome designs to demonstrate fire-rated separation between adjacent dwelling units.

Residential units must be designated by accessibility type per IBC §§ 1104.2 and 1107.6. Provide unit designations on floor plans, site plan, and cover sheet identifying which units meet fully accessible, Type A, or Type B adaptable requirements.

flagged.comment: Fully accessible, Type A, and Type B adaptable dwelling units are not designated on the site plan, floor plans, or cover sheet. Residential buildings are required to identify which units meet these accessibility standards per the adopted 2024 International Building Code.

No architectural floor plans, garage plans, or cover sheet notes are provided showing required accessibility designations: fully accessible, Type A, and Type B adaptable dwelling units. Residential buildings with 39 units require these designations per IBC accessibility standards; submission of architectural plans is required to verify compliance.

Water Benchmarking Application submission and Austin Water director approval documentation are not present in the available site plan documentation. Project is a 39-unit multi-family residential development receiving City of Austin (Austin Water) retail service, making WBA submission a condition of site plan approval per LDC § 25-9-413. Master comment report shows this item is pending (OWB2 status) with requirement to submit and ensure consistency with site data table. Additionally, total GFA is 83,986 sf (below 250,000 SF large development threshold), so pre-release director consultation requirement does not apply. Provide WBA approval documentation from Austin Water director as required condition of site plan release.

Site plan is a multifamily residential project (39 units) with Austin Water retail service, requiring a Water Benchmarking Application as a condition of site plan approval per LDC § 25-9-413. Benchmarking application is confirmed in review with Austin Water (multiple OWB comments pending), but neither the application document nor Austin Water director approval documentation is present on the site plan sheets. GFA (83,986 sf) is below the 250,000 SF large development threshold, so pre-release director consultation is not required, but director approval must be documented.

Water Benchmarking Application submission and Austin Water director approval are not documented. Project is 39 multi-family units (≥5 units) receiving Austin Water retail service, triggering WBA requirement per LDC § 25-9-413(A). Submit completed Water Benchmarking Application with values reconciled to site data table (GFA: 83,986 sf, stories, building coverage), and document Austin Water director approval as a condition of site plan release.

Cross-consistency of square footage values across site data table, parking table, TIA worksheet, and Water Benchmarking Application cannot be verified. Site Data Table shows GFA of 83,986 sf, but the benchmarking application is not included in the available documents for comparison. Master comment report (OWB2) indicates pending requirement to ensure GFA consistency with benchmarking application.

No Smart Housing or income-restricted affordable housing unit designations are identified in the site plan documents or supplementary materials. Cannot verify applicability without project description explicitly stating whether Smart Housing or affordable units are proposed.

Mail kiosk is shown on the site plan but is not dimensioned with width and depth dimensions. Provide floor plan dimensions (length and width) for the mail kiosk on the site plan or on a separate detail sheet.

Residential unit count is inconsistent across submitted documents. Site plan (Sheet 9, Building Data Table) shows 39 units total (16 Two Bedroom + 23 Three Bedroom). TIA Determination Worksheet (Trip Generation table) shows 38 units. These values must reconcile.

Number of stories (maximum 3 stories documented on site plan) cannot be verified for consistency with the Water Benchmarking Application and project narrative. The benchmarking application document is not provided for cross-verification.

If this option was elected, no shower-and-changing facilities are shown on floor plans or site plan (39 units GFA < 100,000 sf would require minimum 2 facilities; GFA = 83,986 sf).
